historical_tests: Both M5K and M5L tests regression only

contact.gold: Multiple road collision probes agree with rendered local road (<=.10m), stable body pose, independently identifiable visible wheel/foot contact support, no occlusion/truncation/floating/penetration ambiguity. AABB/lowest rendered pixel alone never Gold.
contact.candidate: Visible surface and local road plane but contact anatomy or collision/render agreement incomplete
contact.unknown: No stable road support or inconsistent/occluded contact; not absent/free

selective.selection: Val only: highest coverage satisfying all gates in BOTH seeds; no admissible point => no promotion, retain threshold0 diagnostic
selective.confidence: Uncalibrated RGB shape and geometric sensitivity score; no Gold => no VerifiedPosition
selective.output: Unknown preserves candidate and optional conditional xy; ConditionalPosition experimental assumption only; Verified disabled

residual.selection: Val only simultaneous two-seed gates plus per-position near/bias; no admissible gate => stop residual training
residual.oracle: GT vehicle mask diagnostic only, never inference

plane.rgb: Learned original depth fit below RGB component excluding q>=.1; no road GT. Candidate only; unstable fit rejected

shadow.stop: tick P95 > max(1.5 baseline, baseline+20ms) or any tick >1000ms; stop worker and restore alone

sealed.configurations: empty, small/large vehicle, person, cone, occlusion, shifted orientation
sealed.purpose: Independent conditional geometry regression; Gold only by same predeclared evidence. No tuning.
